articles.title: Researchers Hack Snowflake PostgreSQL Database to Gain Full Server-Level Code Execution
articles.summary:
A security test of Snowflake-managed PostgreSQL has shown how a database role with limited privileges could be turned into control of the server running the database. Researchers chained several built-in PostgreSQL features to reach operating-system command execution, even though Snowflake had blocked common ways to run commands and access files through SQL. articles.title: SiteGuard Warns Patching Actively Exploited Security Flaw Could Erase Evidence of Attacks
articles.summary:
EG Secure Solutions has warned that a flaw in SiteGuard Server Edition is being exploited and that applying a fix could remove signs of an earlier attack. The issue, CVE-2026-106931, affects the product’s statistics feature, which is enabled by default. articles.title: Microsoft Pays Researcher $4,000 for Discovering Critical VS Code Security Bypass Flaw
articles.summary:
Microsoft awarded security researcher Sam Chen US$4,000 for reporting a flaw in Visual Studio Code that could let an attacker bypass Workspace Trust protections. The issue, tracked as CVE-2026-81376, affects VS Code versions earlier than 1.136.2 and has a critical CVSS score of 9.6. Microsoft has fixed the flaw; users should update to version 1.136.2 […]

articles.title: Hackers Use Claude, DeepSeek and Grok in AI-Assisted Attacks on South Korean Banks
articles.summary:
Hackers linked to attacks on South Korean banks used Claude Code, DeepSeek, Grok, and Zhipu AI alongside ARTEX, an open-source AI penetration testing framework. The campaign shows how attackers can combine AI services with familiar hacking tools to search for weaknesses across different systems, while leaving evidence that helps investigators trace their work.
